column1: Eight statuses and the CMMN case state each maps to.

column2: Created at 90 days past due with its history. Not yet given an owner.
An owner and a queue are set by the allocation rules. The stage clock starts.
The owner or the Workbench is working a task on the case.
An offer, notice or request is with the customer, with a validity timer running.
An instruction is with a partner, with a service level timer running.
A recommendation is with the approver set by the delegation of authority.
A deviation or a legal hold has paused the case. The prescription clock keeps running.
A milestone that closes the case is reached: cured, settled, sold, or written off with recovery ended.
